3. PACKING AND MARKING 3.1 Packing - The dog feeds shall be packed in clean sound, polythene The biscuits may be packed in cardboard cartons up to lined container. 500 g. The container shall be pilfer-proof, moisture-proof and sturdy enough to withstand rough handling in transit. 3.2 Marking - Each carton/container shall be securely closed and suitably marked or labelled so as to give the following information. a) Name of the material, that is, biscuits, meal or crumbs; b) Name of the manufacturer; 5

IS :11968 -1986 c) d) e) f) g) Batch or code number; Net mass of contents, when packed; Date of manufacture; List of ingredient; and Declaration ( see 2.3.1 ). may also be marked with the Stacdard Mark.
